en.shaykh-tahir-ridha-jaffer: 19.Ibn Abī ʿUmayr narrated from Ḥabīb al-Khathʿamī, from Abū ʿAbdillāh (a) who said, “

The Messenger of Allah (ṣ) said, ‘Should I not inform you of the best among you?’ They said, ‘Yes, O Messenger of Allah!’ He said, ‘Those with the best character, those who are amiable and hospitable, and those who get along with people and with whom others get along well.’”
